topics.name: Topic Structural Crosswalk
topics.purpose: Define how Topic grouping overlays canonical structural dimensions without replacing them, allowing the same node to be read simultaneously by semantic concern and structural role.

semantics.overlay_rule: Topics are semantic grouping overlays across the structural graph.
semantics.multi_topic_rule: One node may appear in multiple Topic traversals while retaining one canonical identity.
semantics.dimension_rule: Topic traversal preserves the node's containment/relation/ownership/authority/dependency edges.
semantics.cross_cut_rule: Cross-cutting mechanisms can be followed as Topic chains across multiple structural owners/modules.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Repeated appearance through Topics is not semantic duplication when canonical identity is the same.
semantics.reader_rule: Readers deduplicate by canonical identity while preserving all Topic contexts.

invariants.rule: A generic reader can resolve canonical identity, Topic context, references and semantic ownership without filesystem or prose heuristics.
